tom: quick flag during onboarding of helix40k-int4v2: enabling rope-folding (freq fold rescale) + prefill coalesce triggers a subtle KV shadowing around the 40960 boundary. manifests as a single-token dropout or unexpected repeat in outputs. repro and logs below. :thinking_face:

elaine: can you paste minimal repro and where you ran it?

 tom: ran on staging (1xA100), tiled int4v2 kernel with prefill coalesce. repro:
```
# repro
python infra/run_infer.py --model helix40k-int4v2 --quant int4v2 --rope-rescale fold --context 45000 \
  --prefill examples/legal_bundle.prefill --coalesce-prefill true --dump-kv /tmp/helix_kv.json
```

ben: logs look noisy but the interesting lines are around 40960 (2^12 * 10). tail:
```
[2026-06-11T22:11:02Z] prefill completed pos=40954
[2026-06-11T22:11:02Z] generate start pos=40954
[2026-06-11T22:11:02Z] kv_fingerprint mismatch pos=40960 stored=0x3af2 expected=0x3af3
[2026-06-11T22:11:02Z] output[40960]="and"
[2026-06-11T22:11:02Z] output[40961]="and"  <-- repeat (shadow)
[2026-06-11T22:11:02Z] fallback: rebuild-kv -> latency spike
```

tom: kv dump snippet (pos -> key_hash):
```
40958: 0x1122aa
40959: 0x2233bb
40960: 0x3af2  <- stored
40961: 0x3af2  <- expected 0x3af3
```

elaine: interesting. rope-folding recomputes the rotary mapping using folded frequency indices. int4v2's packing logic computes per-pos page offsets with a 12-bit local index in some codepaths; my gut says a low-bit drop when folding wraps an index across a page boundary. did you try forcing INDEX_WIDTH=uint32 or disabling fold?

ben: quick smoke: DISABLE_ROPE_FOLD=1 -> no mismatch. INDEX_WIDTH=32 -> no mismatch. so it's the interaction of rope-folding math + narrow index math in tiled int4v2 compaction.

infra-bot: created INC-2026-7890: "helix40k int4v2 KV shadowing when rope-fold rescale + prefill coalesce at ~40k" and linked this thread. Assigned to tom and tagged eng-ml.

elaine: for onboarding checklist: add a "folded-rope + coalesce" kv-consistency smoke. prefills at 32k/40k/45k across fp16/int8/int4v2 and compare kv fingerprints plus token sequences. low false-positive risk and catches this class of bugs.

ben: action items:
- tom: open runtime PR to widen index math for int4v2 compaction path (use 32-bit local indices) and add unit test that emulates fold wrap at page boundary. include perf/memory delta in PR description.
- elaine: add smoke entry to onboarding evals and update docs warning about rope-fold caveat for int4v2 until fix merges.
- ben: run token-diff bench overnight (fp16 vs int4v2 fold vs int4v2 no-fold) and upload diffs + kv maps.
tom: perf note: switching to 32-bit local indices increased metadata by ~0.9% for helix40k config, and no measurable latency regression in our canary. will include numbers in PR.

elaine: if widening indexes looks heavy for some embedded configs, alternative is to compute a per-page base hash update during fold remap instead of relying on global index math. mention that in PR for alternatives.

ben: thanks, i'll watch the overnight run. if token diffs remain within probabilistic variance after the index widen, we can mark helix40k-int4v2 as "ready for canary". otherwise escalate to "needs manual eval". :eyes:

triage-bot: incident updated INC-2026-7890 with logs and attached kv dumps from tom.

tom: opening PR now and will paste link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
